summary: Only the trace relations of the new indices (k, false), at the elements (τ_k^c)⁻¹ and (φ_k^c)⁻¹, are new. By conjugate self-duality each trace at g of an element (h_k^c)^{−i}g equals cycInv^{t−1} of it times a trace at h_k^i(g^c)⁻¹; as cycInv((τ_k^c)⁻¹) = 1 and cycInv((φ_k^c)⁻¹)^e ≡ 1 mod ℓ^ν, the new relation is cycInv(g)^{t−1} times the old relation at (g^c)⁻¹ minus X_k times a combination of the families ℓ^ν·tr, all in 𝒥.

steps.claim: The first two clauses of IsTraceIdeal (the variables X_k and the coefficients of the characteristic polynomials of the u_x(g) lie in S) do not involve τ, φ, and for every g the family x ↦ ℓ^ν·tr u_x(g) lies in 𝒥 by h; it remains, for every g and every index (k, b) of K × Bool, to show that the family x ↦ tr((u_x(τ'_{k,b}) − 1)·u_x(g)) − X_k·tr(((X − 1)e_k)(u_x(φ'_{k,b}))·u_x(g)) lies in 𝒥, where τ'_{k,b} = withConjInv τ (k, b) and φ'_{k,b} = withConjInv φ (k, b). The two values of b are treated separately (write k = j below).
steps.lean:
h.imp_right (.imp_right fun k g ↦ (k g).imp_right fun a (j, b) ↦ b.rec (by
  have H h i x : (u x (withConjInv h (j, false) ^ i * g)).1.trace = cycInv ℓ _ O (withConjInv h (j,
    false) ^ i * g) ^ (t - 1) • (u x (h j ^ i * (conjGal g)⁻¹)).1.trace := by
    simpa [idOrConjInv, cycInv, trace_mul_comm _⁻¹, O.1.smul_def] using
      (hu x).trace_conj ((h j)⁻¹ ^ i * conjGal g)
  choose d hd using (hw.cycInv_withConjInv O (j, false)).2
  convert 𝒥.smul_of_tower_mem (cycInv ℓ _ O g ^ (t - 1))
    (sub_mem ((k (conjGal g)⁻¹).2 j) (𝒥.smul_mem ⟨_, h.1 j⟩ (sum_mem fun i _ ↦ 𝒥.smul_of_tower_mem
    (d ((t - 1) * i) * ((X - 1) * e j).coeff i) (k (φ j ^ i * (conjGal g)⁻¹)).1)))
  simp [*, Subalgebra.smul_def, ↓aeval_eq_sum_range, sum_mul, sub_mul, mul_sum, mul_sub,
    eq_add_of_sub_eq' (hd _), sub_sub, add_mul, mul_add, MvPolynomial.smul_eq_C_mul,
    by simpa [hw.cycInv_withConjInv, mul_pow, ← pow_mul'] using And.intro H (H τ <| Bool.toNat ·)]
  ac_rfl) (a j))

  choose d hd using (hw.cycInv_withConjInv O (j, false)).2

    (d ((t - 1) * i) * ((X - 1) * e j).coeff i) (k (φ j ^ i * (conjGal g)⁻¹)).1)))
  simp [*, Subalgebra.smul_def, ↓aeval_eq_sum_range, sum_mul, sub_mul, mul_sum, mul_sub,

steps.claim: For a family h : K → Gal(Ω/E) (it is used for h = τ and h = φ), i ∈ ℕ and x ∈ Y: tr u_x(((h_j^c)⁻¹)^i·g) = cycInv(((h_j^c)⁻¹)^i·g)^{t−1}·tr u_x(h_j^i·(g^c)⁻¹). This is the conjugate self-duality tr u_x(y^c) = cycInv(y)^{t−1}·tr u_x(y⁻¹) of u_x (hu x) at y = (h_j⁻¹)^i·g^c, whose conjugate is y^c = ((h_j^c)⁻¹)^i·g (with cycInv(y^c) = cycInv(y)), together with tr(AB) = tr(BA) to move y⁻¹ = (g^c)⁻¹·h_j^i to h_j^i·(g^c)⁻¹.

steps.lean: choose d hd using (hw.cycInv_withConjInv O (j, false)).2

steps.claim: The relation of index (j, false) at g is identified with the element cycInv(g)^{t−1}·[R_j((g^c)⁻¹) − X_j·Σ_i d((t − 1)·i)·c_i·(x ↦ ℓ^ν·tr u_x(φ_j^i·(g^c)⁻¹))] of 𝒥, where R_j((g^c)⁻¹) is the given relation of index j at the element (g^c)⁻¹ (in 𝒥 by h), c_i the coefficients of (X − 1)·e_j, and the families x ↦ ℓ^ν·tr u_x(·) lie in 𝒥 by h; 𝒥 is an S-module, X_j ∈ S (h), and 𝒥 is closed under multiplication by scalars of O. It remains to verify the identity of the two families.

    (sub_mem ((k (conjGal g)⁻¹).2 j) (𝒥.smul_mem ⟨_, h.1 j⟩ (sum_mem fun i _ ↦ 𝒥.smul_of_tower_mem
    (d ((t - 1) * i) * ((X - 1) * e j).coeff i) (k (φ j ^ i * (conjGal g)⁻¹)).1)))

steps.claim: The identity: expand ((X − 1)e_j)(u_x(φ'_j)) = Σ_i c_i·u_x(φ'_j)^i; by step 1.1.1 (for h = φ and every i, for h = τ and i ∈ {0, 1}) each trace at an element (h_j^c)^{−i}·g becomes cycInv(g)^{t−1}·cycInv(h'_j)^{(t−1)i} times a trace at h_j^i·(g^c)⁻¹, where cycInv((τ_j^c)⁻¹) = 1 and cycInv((φ_j^c)⁻¹)^{(t−1)i} = 1 + ℓ^ν·d((t − 1)i) (step 1.1.2); after distributing products over sums the two families agree up to the order of the factors.
